1874-1981-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1874-1981-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3330-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3330-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1308-4772-4826-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

301-7804-7860.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
301-7804-7860.description:
Activate Mogg Raider by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, revealing the top card of your library, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin and then putting the card back on top of your library.
Resolve the Mogg Raider ability.
Repeat.

413-801-5220-7855.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Impulsive Pilferer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Impulsive Pilferer onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling Impulsive Pilferer from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer from exile by paying {R}.
When Impulsive Pilferer enters, Blasting Station triggers untapping Blasting Station
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3010-3259-4885.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3010-3259-4885.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

955-6723-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
955-6723-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
955-6723-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-5997-7376.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Iraxxa
1618-2440-5997-7376.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Charnel Serenade.
Charnel Serenade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Charnel Serenade.
Repeat.
1618-2440-5997-7376.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Iraxxa. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

3771-4217-7300.description:
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Animar.
Repeat from step 3.
3771-4217-7300.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {2} if Animar starts with +1/+1 counters.

2921-5687-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2921-5687-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Skittering Precursor and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
2921-5687-7084.notes: You can instead sacrifice the creature tokens to their own abilities instead of sacrificing them to Bartolomé del Presidio.

4871-5686-6705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4871-5686-6705.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token due to Quina.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood artifact token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

4499-4747-7296.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Alena.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may blink any other creature(s) you control.

3490-4659-6458-6824.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
3490-4659-6458-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1987-2187-4276-6991.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2187-4276-6991.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Donnie & April and Possessed Skaab.
When Donnie & April and Possessed Skaab enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2187-4276-6991.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1786-2541-6824.description:
Activate Benthic Biomancer by paying {1}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

586-2906-5258-5618-6798.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 1 life this turn.
586-2906-5258-5618-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

997-2843-6553.easyPrerequisites: Unholy Indenture attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
997-2843-6553.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

1806-2034-5997-6333.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Eternal Scourge is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to Hades
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Alien Warrior and Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

273-3156-4242-4763.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Su-Chi.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk by sacrificing Su-Chi, targeting Koll.
When Su-Chi dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Su-Chi by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1987-3617-4423-4823.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-3617-4423-4823.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

4871-5231-6115.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Ozox, adding {R}.
When Ozox dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Ozox trigger, creating a legendary 2/1 Jumblebones creature token.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Jumblebones, adding {R}.
When Jumblebones dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Jumblebones trigger, returning Ozox from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Ozox by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

654-1541-2239-5220-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Ardent Elementalist, adding {R}.
When Ardent Elementalist dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ardent Elementalist on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Ardent Elementalist from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, and creating six tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When Ardent Elementalist and the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers six times and Ardent Elementalist triggers once.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2034-3862-5003.easyPrerequisites: You do not control an Army.
2034-3862-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Orcish Bowmasters, adding {C}{C}.
When Orcish Bowmasters dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Orcish Bowmasters from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target and creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

224-1737-2419-4832.notablePrerequisites:
Ensoul Artifact attached to Prototype Portal.
Prototype Portal does not have summoning sickness.
224-1737-2419-4832.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by tapping it, creating a token copy of Treasure Vault.
When the Treasure Vault token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure Vault tokens, you may tap them for infinite mana, and then use a Treasure Vault to create infinite Treasure toknes.

413-1734-3603-4605.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Preston and Blasting Station.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, choosing not to exile a creature.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 white Illusion.
The Fiend Hunter token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter token's trigger, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token.
The token dies, returning the nontoken Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities, dealing infinite damage to any target(s).

724-1339-1689-4050.description:
Activate Hidetsugu by paying {B} and sacrificing a creature, drawing two cards.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {B}.
Repeat.
